What We Do

Grooming from tail to toes

Everything your dog or cat needs to look and feel their best, tailored to their coat and temperament.

Full Groom

Bath, breed-style haircut, blow-dry, nail trim and ear cleaning — the complete works.

Bath & Brush

A deep, gentle clean with conditioner, a full brush-out and a nail trim to finish.

Nail Trim & Grind

Quick, calm trims with a smooth grind finish so paws stay comfortable.

De-Shedding Treatment

A deep coat treatment that cuts loose-hair shedding way down for fluffier breeds.

Puppy's First Groom

A patient, positive introduction to grooming so young pups learn it's nothing to fear.

Ear & Teeth Add-Ons

Fresh breath and clean, tidy ears to round out any groom appointment.

Good to Know

Frequently asked questions

How do I book an appointment?

Fill out the appointment request form above with your pet's breed and the service you'd like, or give us a call at (720) 885-3744. We'll get back to you to confirm a time.

Do you groom all breeds and sizes?

Yes — from tiny pups to big fluffy guys, plus cats. We tailor every groom to your pet's coat and temperament.

My pet gets anxious. Can you help?

Absolutely. We go slow, stay calm, and make first visits gentle and positive so your pet learns there's nothing to fear.

How long does a full groom take?

Usually two to four hours depending on size and coat. We'll give you a pick-up window when you drop off.

Where are you located?

We're at 2020 Youngfield St, Lakewood, CO 80215, serving Lakewood and the greater Denver metro area.
